note: The Instructions exempt Commentary and Perspective from five requirements. A model that pattern-matches the Regular Article checklist will report those five as missing; a model that reads the conditions will not. The discriminating metric is therefore the false-positive count on the exempt items. Eight rules that are NOT exempted are violated so that competence is measured at the same time -- otherwise a model that reports nothing at all would score perfectly.

exempt_items.requirement: An abstract of no more than 250 words is required.
exempt_items.exemption: For the "Editorial" or "Commentary and Perspective" categories, an abstract is not necessary.

exempt_items.requirement: A short statement of less than 100 words about the significance of the paper should be added.
exempt_items.exemption: it is not necessary for "Editorial" or "Commentary and Perspective".

exempt_items.requirement: A Running Title not exceeding 50 characters including spaces is required.
exempt_items.exemption: it is not necessary for "Editorial" or "Commentary and Perspective".

exempt_items.requirement: One figure should be attached for use as the graphical abstract.
exempt_items.exemption: for every paper except "Editorial" or "Commentary and Perspective" papers.

exempt_items.requirement: Authors are required to provide sufficient details in the Materials and Methods section and the Results section.
exempt_items.exemption: except in the categories of Editorial or Commentary and Perspective.
